stories.headline: Pearsall's Season Ends Before It Starts and Deebo Rides Back Into Santa Clara
stories.read: Well pardner, John Lynch stepped up Saturday and said it plain: Ricky Pearsall needs surgery on that PCL and he is done for 2026, straight onto the injured list, six to twelve months before he walks right again. The Niners didn't sit on their hands neither, makin' Deebo Samuel's homecomin' official the same afternoon. Here's your play: every throw Pearsall was fixin' to catch just got dumped back in the pot, and Mike Evans and Jauan Jennings are standin' closest to the pile. But Deebo is the vein worth pannin', because the saloon has him priced like a broke-down mule and he just walked into real work with a coach who knows exactly how to feed him. Pearsall's a dry well till 2027.

stories.headline: Pacheco's Knee Gives Out and Gibbs Owners Just Lost Their Insurance
stories.read: Dan Campbell came out and allowed that Isiah Pacheco is nursin' a sprained MCL, and swears the man will be saddled up for the opener against New Orleans. Trouble is, Pacheco has missed seventeen games in three seasons, and a fella with that record don't get the benefit of the doubt on Doc's ranch. He was goin' for pocket change late in drafts as the spare horse behind Jahmyr Gibbs, and that spare horse is now walkin' funny. If you own Gibbs, quit countin' on Pacheco and go find yourself a cheaper cover. Everybody else, let some other greenhorn gamble that pick.

stories.headline: Cam Ward Sprays It All Over Nashville and Rookie Carnell Tate Comes Home Empty
stories.read: Titans opener down in Tennessee, and Ward went five-of-twelve for fifty-seven yards against San Francisco's second string, missin' slants like a greenhorn shootin' cans off a fence. Carnell Tate, the fourth man taken in the whole land grab, got looked at three times and hauled in exactly nothin'. Robert Saleh says the mechanics were just runnin' fast and he ain't worried, and preseason lies plenty, but Doc don't pay real money for hope. Ward's a rent-him-for-one-ride arm this year, and Tate is a fella you let the herd chase two rounds before you'd ever touch him. Meanwhile Tony Pollard punched one in the money patch. That's the Tennessee man who actually pays rent.
